title: Projects
description: Products you recognise, and the environments running for them on this host.
catalogDescription: A Project is the product. An Environment is one Compose stack running for it on this host.
needsDatabaseHint: They are decisions rather than observations, so they are persisted. Start PostgreSQL and the catalog comes back; environments still list without it.
catalogEmptyHint: Create a product, then attach repositories and adopt the environments running for it.

create.title: New project
create.description: A name and a slug. Repositories and environments are attached afterwards.
create.name: Name
create.slugHint: Also what an environment's portta.project label must say to be adopted automatically.

emptyHint: An environment appears when Compose is up on this host. Adopt it onto a Project with the portta.project label or by hand.

sourceReason.repoMatch: its repository belongs to this project
sourceReason.label: declared by its portta.project label
sourceReason.path: it runs from a directory of this project

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Compose projects on this host that belong to this project, and why.
environments.empty: Nothing is running for this project
environments.emptyHint: Start an environment, label it portta.project with this slug, or link one by hand.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Projected from GitHub. Every row says how old the answer is.
issues.needsDatabaseHint: They are a projection of GitHub, kept locally so they answer while GitHub is unreachable.

repositoriesCard.title: Repositories
repositoriesCard.description: The Git of this product. Local first; GitHub is optional metadata.
repositoriesCard.emptyHint: Add one the host scanned, one the GitHub App was granted, or name it by hand.

attach.description: Only repositories the GitHub App installation granted can be attached.
attach.hint: Configure the GitHub App under Settings → GitHub and press Sync. A project works without it; it just has no repositories.
attach.noneGranted: No repository has been granted yet
attach.noneGrantedHint: Install the GitHub App on the repositories this project owns, then press Sync under Settings → GitHub.

overview.noMeasurement: No environment of this project is measured right now.

settings.title: Project
settings.description: What the panel keeps about this product. Nothing here touches a repository or a container.
settings.relativePathHint: One first-level directory of PORTTA_PROJECTS_HOME. Files are never moved.
settings.deleteDescription: Removes the registration and what Portta keeps about it. Nothing on the host changes.
settings.deleteRemoves: Removed: the project, its repositories' registrations, its tasks, notes, sessions and activity.
settings.deleteKeeps: Kept: every container, volume, network, working directory and GitHub issue. Environments go back to unassigned.
